title: Base change of a standard smooth presentation
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $A$ an $R$-algebra with a standard smooth presentation [def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra] given by $n\ge c\ge0$, $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ and $\alpha:R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)\xrightarrow{\sim}A$, and let $\psi:R\to R'$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. For $f\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ let $f^\psi\in R'[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be the polynomial obtained by applying $\psi$ to the coefficients. Then the $R'$-algebra homomorphism $R'[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to R'\otimes_RA$, $x_i\mapsto1\otimes\alpha(\bar x_i)$, induces an isomorphism of $R'$-algebras $R'[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1^\psi,\dots,f_c^\psi)\xrightarrow{\sim}R'\otimes_RA$, and this is a standard smooth presentation of $R'\otimes_RA$ over $R'$ with the same integers $n$ and $c$; in particular $R'\otimes_RA$ is standard smooth over $R'$ with a presentation of relative dimension $n-c$.
